unknowns.question: Why do seven ASAR-declared hashes differ from the installed unpacked native files even though codesign --verify --deep --strict accepts the installed application?
Do macOS permission acquisition, user intervention, cancellation, late replies and service restart enforce the statically declared behavior on this host?
Which complete native branches authenticate IPC senders, revalidate target/action policy, preserve clipboard, and reject interrupted actions before dispatch?
What do the installer, authorization plug-in and guardian actually install and enforce during locked-computer use?
What is the actual trusted/untrusted evaluator, filesystem/process/network authority and failure isolation inside the shipped native node_repl executable?
How do capture pixels, AX bounds, virtual cursor coordinates and input coordinates remain coherent across Retina scaling, window moves and multiple displays?
Which account/model/server policy enables Computer Use and what capture contents or action metadata leave the whole product beyond the inspected telemetry module?
